desc.anima:
In systems exclusively supported by {entity.anima}:
- {entity.extractor} produces items every turn.
- Newly built buildings have 1 less max hp.
- {entity.laboratory} is disabled.
desc.extractor:
Produces an item every {entity.extractor.cycles_to_output} turns.
On death, creates a deposit of what it was last extracting where it died.
